title: Expense eligibility taxonomy
description: Classify travel expenses as eligible, conditionally eligible or prohibited; distinguish business necessity from convenience.

title: Receipt and evidence hierarchy
description: Define acceptable evidence, itemisation, proof of payment, merchant identity and alternatives when receipts are unavailable.

title: Corporate card usage controls
description: Set permitted card use, prohibited personal spend, transaction ownership, security and cardholder responsibilities.

title: Corporate card reconciliation
description: Define statement matching, coding, submission timelines, dispute handling and escalation of unreconciled transactions.

title: Cash advance issuance
description: Set eligibility, business purpose, approvals, advance sizing, payment and controls against duplicate funding.

title: Cash advance reconciliation
description: Require itemised settlement, return of unused funds, evidence, aging follow-up and escalation.

title: Expense report submission standards
description: Define report grouping, trip association, required fields, currency, cost centre and submission completeness.

title: Expense approval and segregation of duties
description: Separate claimant, reviewer, budget owner and payment roles; prohibit self-approval and conflicted approvals.

title: Expense category mapping
description: Standardise categories and coding for lodging, meals, transport, fees, communications and incidental costs.

title: Foreign currency conversion
description: Specify use of the approved expense platform or finance-published conversion method, transaction-date evidence and no invented rates.

title: Actuals versus per diem selection
description: Prevent duplicate reimbursement and explain when approved allowance methods replace itemised actual claims.

title: Business meal claims
description: Define business purpose, attendee names/roles, itemised bill, reasonable spend and approval requirements.

title: Client entertainment and hospitality
description: Set pre-approval, attendee and business-purpose records, customer-contract checks and heightened review.

title: Gifts and promotional items
description: Require compliance review, recipient/purpose documentation and checks against anti-bribery rules; prohibit cash equivalents.

title: Tips and gratuities
description: Set reasonableness and documentation principles while deferring local customs and limits to country addenda.

title: Mileage and personal vehicle claims
description: Require approved route/mileage evidence, business-purpose logs and system-maintained local rates; no global rate is prescribed.

title: Parking, tolls and congestion charges
description: Define business-trip eligibility, proof, route relevance and treatment of penalties or fines.

title: Laundry and incidental expenses
description: Set eligibility by trip duration and business necessity, with local caps controlled by country addenda.

title: Mobile, data and connectivity expenses
description: Distinguish incremental business travel charges from personal plans and require itemised evidence.

title: Visa, passport and travel-document fees
description: Define business-related eligibility, prior authorisation, receipts and treatment of personal renewals.

title: Travel insurance and assistance fees
description: Clarify approved purchase channels, duplicate-cover prevention and required documentation.

title: Medical and emergency out-of-pocket claims
description: Define urgent reporting, privacy-minimised evidence, insurer-first routing where appropriate and confidential handling.

title: Lost receipt declarations
description: Set declaration fields, corroborating evidence, frequency monitoring and heightened approval for repeat claims.

title: Duplicate claim prevention
description: Describe matching across card feeds, receipts, dates, merchants, amounts and prior reimbursements.

title: Split transaction detection
description: Prohibit splitting to evade approval limits; define aggregation logic and review signals.

title: Late expense submissions
description: Set global process expectations, local deadlines precedence, reason codes and escalation without overriding local rules.

title: Expense report correction and resubmission
description: Define return-to-claimant, correction history, resubmission and audit trail requirements.

title: Reimbursement payment controls
description: Define verified payee details, payment status, failed payment handling and separation from approval.

title: Payroll or receivable recovery
description: Require notice, dispute opportunity and locally compliant HR/Finance review before any recovery or deduction.

title: Expense disputes and appeals
description: Provide a neutral review path, evidence standards, decision recording and escalation outside the original approver.

title: Audit sampling methodology
description: Define risk-based and random sampling, population integrity, sample documentation and repeatable testing.

title: Expense audit case management
description: Set case ownership, evidence handling, findings, remediation, closure and access restrictions.

title: Fraud indicators and escalation
description: List risk signals without treating them as proof; require confidential escalation and fair investigation.

title: Expense policy breach response
description: Define coaching, correction, recovery consideration and formal escalation proportionate to evidence and severity.

title: Record retention and retrieval
description: Set retention according to approved corporate schedules and local law; preserve retrievable audit trails.

title: VAT GST and tax data capture
description: Capture invoice fields needed by local Finance; do not infer tax treatment or provide jurisdictional tax advice.

title: Tax invoice validation workflow
description: Route questionable invoices to local Finance and preserve originals, corrections and validation outcomes.

title: Third-party and contractor expenses
description: Require contract-based eligibility, payer identification, duplicate-claim checks and equivalent evidence.

title: Customer-billable expense controls
description: Require contract mapping, customer approval where stipulated, project coding and no unsupported pass-through.

title: Supplier-paid travel and expense disclosure
description: Record benefits, sponsorship, business purpose and compliance review; prevent duplicate reimbursement.

title: Subscriptions and recurring travel tools
description: Require business owner, procurement review, renewal controls and separation from personal subscriptions.

title: Non-travel spend submitted as travel
description: Define rejection or rerouting for office supplies, meals unrelated to travel, gifts and other non-travel categories.

title: Alcohol and restricted hospitality controls
description: Apply stricter review, customer and local-rule checks; prohibit reimbursement where corporate or customer rules disallow it.

title: Expense platform mandatory fields
description: Define required structured data, validation rules, attachments, policy version and exception reason fields.

title: Expense analytics and KPI definitions
description: Standardise cycle time, exception rate, missing receipt rate, card reconciliation, recovery and audit findings.

title: High-risk merchant and MCC review
description: Use merchant-category data as a screening signal, with human review and context before adverse conclusions.

title: Personal spend on corporate card
description: Require prompt repayment, disclosure, coding and review; distinguish accidental misuse from deliberate abuse.

title: Cash, cash-equivalent and ATM withdrawal controls
description: Restrict withdrawals to approved need, require reconciliation and prohibit unapproved cash-equivalent purchases.

title: Expense approval thresholds and local overlays
description: Apply the current authority matrix and country addenda; do not create new monetary limits in this global standard.

title: Expense policy interpretation and precedence
description: Resolve conflicts using current global policy, country addenda, role overlays, approved exceptions and law in the defined order.

title: Traveller duty of care framework
description: Define pre-trip risk awareness, reachable traveller details, escalation channels and organisational care responsibilities.

title: Pre-trip destination risk assessment
description: Require risk review proportionate to destination, itinerary, traveller profile and current official advisories.

title: High-risk destination authorisation
description: Require documented risk acceptance, senior approval, security assessment and periodic reassessment.

title: Travel security briefings
description: Set briefing triggers, content, acknowledgement and refresh requirements for elevated-risk travel.

title: Traveller location and check-in protocol
description: Define voluntary/necessary itinerary data, check-in cadence by risk, missed-check-in escalation and privacy safeguards.

title: Emergency contact and itinerary records
description: Maintain accurate emergency contacts and itinerary access for authorised responders only.

title: Medical fitness and travel readiness
description: Provide confidential fitness-to-travel process, reasonable accommodation and referral to qualified professionals.

title: Pre-existing condition and medication planning
description: Encourage traveller-led medical preparation and confidential assistance without requiring unnecessary diagnosis disclosure.

title: Vaccination and health-entry requirements
description: Direct travellers to authoritative destination requirements and qualified medical advice; avoid static medical claims.

title: Travel insurance coverage overview
description: Explain policy-document verification, covered categories, exclusions, limits and insurer confirmation requirements.

title: Emergency medical assistance workflow
description: Define emergency-first response, insurer/assistance provider contact, local emergency services and company notification.

title: Medical evacuation and repatriation
description: Set insurer/security coordination, decision authority and documentation for evacuation or repatriation.

title: Accident and injury reporting
description: Require prompt safety reporting, incident facts, evidence preservation and privacy-minimised records.

title: Personal safety and situational awareness
description: Set general precautions, local briefing, secure transport and escalation principles without guaranteeing safety.

title: Ground transport safety standards
description: Define approved providers, seatbelt use, vehicle condition, fatigue considerations and risk-based alternatives.

title: Rental vehicle safety and authorisation
description: Require licence validity, insurance confirmation, vehicle checks and local driving eligibility verification.

title: Driving fatigue and journey limits
description: Require rest planning and prohibit driving when impaired, fatigued or medically unfit.

title: Remote site and industrial facility visits
description: Require host induction, PPE confirmation, access authorisation and site-specific safety briefing.

title: Personal protective equipment for travel
description: Define responsibility for required PPE, suitability checks, replacement and site-specific standards.

title: Solo traveller safeguards
description: Set risk-based check-ins, transport planning, accommodation considerations and escalation support.

title: Accessibility and reasonable travel accommodation
description: Provide confidential request handling, individual assessment and equivalent safety standards.

title: Travel with service animals or assistance equipment
description: Require advance coordination, carrier/destination checks and accessibility support while protecting privacy.

title: Natural disaster and severe weather response
description: Define monitoring, shelter/evacuation instructions, travel suspension and approved rebooking support.

title: Civil unrest and security incident response
description: Set shelter, avoid-area, contact and evacuation escalation steps based on security advice.

title: Terrorism and targeted threat response
description: Prioritise immediate safety, local emergency services, security escalation and controlled communications.

title: Pandemic and communicable disease response
description: Provide adaptable risk assessment, hygiene, isolation and return-to-work coordination aligned to current authorities.

title: Traveller missing or uncontactable
description: Define staged welfare checks, escalation thresholds by risk, emergency contact use and incident command.

title: Kidnap extortion and hostile detention escalation
description: Restrict response to trained security leadership, specialist assistance and authorised communications.

title: Insurance claims and incident evidence
description: Set notification deadlines per insurer, evidence capture, claim ownership and secure record retention.

title: Post-trip wellbeing and incident debrief
description: Offer confidential support, lessons learned, corrective actions and non-retaliation for safety reporting.

title: Global policy v1.1 — approval matrix clarification
description: Clarifies approval sequencing and delegation; effective 2026-03-01; prior version remains applicable to earlier approved trips.

title: Global policy v1.2 — booking channel clarification
description: Clarifies approved booking-channel use and exception recording; effective 2026-04-01.

title: Global policy v1.3 — travel purpose evidence
description: Adds structured business-purpose and project-reference fields; effective 2026-05-01.

title: Global policy v1.4 — emergency booking pathway
description: Clarifies emergency booking authorisation and post-event record completion; effective 2026-06-01.

title: Global policy v1.5 — accessibility coordination
description: Clarifies confidential accommodation workflow and supplier coordination; effective 2026-07-01.

title: Global policy v1.6 — supplier sponsorship disclosure
description: Adds disclosure and compliance review for supplier-funded travel; effective 2026-08-01.

title: Global policy v1.7 — itinerary data access
description: Clarifies authorised access, retention and privacy safeguards; effective 2026-09-01.

title: Global policy v1.8 — disruption decision rights
description: Clarifies cancellation and rebooking decision ownership; effective 2026-10-01.

title: Global policy v1.9 — expense evidence standard
description: Clarifies receipt and alternate-evidence hierarchy; effective 2026-11-01.

title: Global policy v2.0 — consolidated governance release
description: Consolidates approved clarifications through 2026-11-15; effective 2026-12-01.

title: Historical global policy v0.8 — archived baseline
description: Archived synthetic baseline effective 2025-01-01; superseded and not applicable to new bookings.

title: Historical global policy v0.9 — archived baseline
description: Archived synthetic revision effective 2025-07-01; superseded by v1.0.

title: Historical global policy v1.0 — initial release
description: Initial synthetic release effective 2026-01-01; retain for historical trip adjudication.

title: Historical approval matrix v1.0
description: Historical delegation table snapshot effective 2026-01-01; current authority must be checked separately.

title: Historical approval matrix v1.1
description: Revised authority snapshot effective 2026-06-01; replaces earlier matrix from effective date.

title: Historical cabin class schedule
description: Archived cabin eligibility schedule effective 2025-07-01; do not apply to new travel.

title: Historical hotel allowance schedule
description: Archived illustrative schedule; country addenda and current platform caps take precedence.

title: Historical meal allowance schedule
description: Archived illustrative schedule; not a current entitlement.

title: Historical mileage schedule
description: Archived rates; use current country configuration in expense platform.

title: Historical receipt threshold schedule
description: Archived thresholds; current local finance instructions govern.

title: Amendment precedence and effective-date rules
description: Define issue date, effective date, transition and treatment of already-ticketed trips.

title: Amendment notification and acknowledgement
description: Define stakeholder notices, training, acknowledgement and exception handling.

title: Policy version metadata schema
description: Standardise policy ID, version, owner, approver, effective date, supersedes, status and jurisdiction.

title: Superseded document identification
description: Require visible archived status, links to successor and retrieval controls to avoid stale answers.

title: Trip booked before policy change
description: Define which provisions govern already-approved and ticketed trips, subject to law and explicit transition terms.

title: Trip occurring across policy effective date
description: Define prospective application to new decisions and preserve approved commitments unless amendment says otherwise.

title: Expense claim filed after policy change
description: Define claim adjudication based on travel date, incurred date, transition rules and applicable local requirements.

title: Conflicting global and country amendment
description: Apply legal requirements and defined precedence; route unresolved ambiguity to Global Mobility and local Finance.

title: Country addendum version mismatch
description: Require confirmation of jurisdiction, effective date and current approved addendum before applying caps.

title: Role overlay version mismatch
description: Use current grade and role assignment at the relevant approval/travel date; preserve audit evidence.

title: Exception approval expiry
description: Define expiry, revalidation and prohibition on reusing one-off approvals for later trips.

title: Temporary policy waiver register
description: Define owner, scope, rationale, start/end date, impacted population and closure review.

title: Policy correction versus substantive amendment
description: Distinguish editorial corrections from changes to entitlements, controls or approval authority.

title: Urgent interim policy notice
description: Define temporary controls, named approver, expiry and conversion into a controlled policy revision.

title: Policy withdrawal and retirement
description: Set retirement approval, archive handling, successor mapping and downstream system updates.

title: Policy migration and crosswalk
description: Map legacy policy references to current IDs without assuming identical meanings.

title: Historical trip audit protocol
description: Require version-at-travel-date reconstruction and prohibit retroactive use of later restrictions.

title: Policy source-of-truth register
description: Identify authoritative repository, ownership, publication controls and stale-copy reporting.

title: Amendment impact assessment
description: Require review of country, grade, role, expense, safety, technology and supplier dependencies.

title: Policy change approval workflow
description: Define legal, finance, security, HR, procurement and business-owner consultation as relevant.

title: Country-specific temporary restriction notice
description: Set jurisdiction, scope, authority, start/end, traveller communication and supersession details.

title: System configuration release note
description: Map policy changes to booking/expense platform controls, testing, deployment and rollback.

title: Policy interpretation bulletin
description: Clarify a recurring ambiguity without silently changing the underlying entitlement.

title: Annual policy review record
description: Set review cadence, evidence of consultation, decisions, open risks and owner sign-off.

title: Historical policy interpretation and decision log
description: Preserve approved interpretations, affected policy clauses, decision owner, rationale, effective period and review trigger; interpretations do not override law or amend entitlements by implication.

title: Multi-country itinerary with differing caps
description: Apply each country rule to the relevant spend and location, preserve transit distinctions and prevent cherry-picking.

title: Home-country employee travelling from a third country
description: Determine employing entity, trip origin, host location, tax/immigration referral and approval ownership.

title: Cross-border day trip without overnight stay
description: Clarify transport, meal eligibility, working time and border compliance checks by jurisdiction.

title: Transit through a restricted jurisdiction
description: Require security and legal review of transit exposure, route alternatives and data/device controls.

title: Multi-entity cost allocation
description: Require sponsoring entity, cost centre split, intercompany approval and single-claim prevention.

title: International assignment versus business trip
description: Route extended relocation/assignment cases to Global Mobility rather than applying ordinary travel rules by default.

title: Temporary assignment with repeated commuting
description: Assess assignment classification, frequency, home-base treatment and local specialist review.

title: Cross-border remote work extension
description: Require HR, tax, immigration, security and manager review before work location changes.

title: Business travel combined with personal leave
description: Separate business and personal costs, establish fare baseline and obtain approval before booking.

title: Personal trip inserted between business destinations
description: Require itinerary comparison, incremental-cost evidence and no company funding of personal segments.

title: Open-jaw and multi-city airfare
description: Compare logical routing, business purpose, fare construction and approval for incremental cost.

title: Separate tickets and self-transfer risk
description: Require connection-risk assessment, baggage/visa checks and approval for self-transfer exposure.

title: Codeshare and partner airline booking
description: Validate approved channel, operating carrier details, baggage and disruption support.

title: Rail plus air intermodal itinerary
description: Compare door-to-door time, safety, emissions, connections and local entitlement rules.

title: Overnight layover caused by schedule
description: Determine necessity, safe accommodation and additional meal/transport eligibility.

title: Visa appointment and consular travel
description: Define business-purpose eligibility, fee ownership, time off and local document requirements.

title: Work authorisation ambiguity
description: Stop work activity pending qualified immigration/legal confirmation; travel permission is not assumed to confer work permission.

title: Passport validity or entry refusal risk
description: Require authoritative entry-rule verification and escalation before ticketing.

title: Sanctions and restricted-party screening
description: Route parties, destinations, payments and services through Legal/Compliance screening before commitment.

title: Export-controlled equipment carried across borders
description: Require classification, licences, customs documentation and Security/Legal approval.

title: Company device crossing sensitive borders
description: Apply security travel profile, encryption, data minimisation and approved device handling.

title: Customer site access with customer-specific travel rules
description: Reconcile contract, site rules and company minimum controls; escalate conflicts before travel.

title: Customer requests premium travel outside policy
description: Require documented business rationale, customer contract check and authorised exception; no verbal-only approval.

title: Customer-funded travel with company booking
description: Document payer, reimbursement path, contract terms and duplicate funding safeguards.

title: Third-party hosted conference travel
description: Disclose sponsorship, evaluate compliance risk and obtain approval before acceptance.

title: Supplier-funded travel offered to employee
description: Require compliance review, conflict assessment and written disposition before acceptance.

title: Group travel for a dispersed project team
description: Use consolidated risk review, budget control, traveller roster and disruption contingency.

title: Executive travel with security arrangements
description: Apply security-led assessment and documented rationale while preserving audit and cost governance.

title: Traveller changes employing entity mid-trip
description: Determine responsible entity and approvals for remaining travel and expenses without double payment.

title: Traveller changes grade during approval cycle
description: Apply the relevant grade rule at the defined decision date and record any transition determination.

title: Traveller has dual role or matrix reporting
description: Identify single accountable budget owner and resolve conflicting instructions before commitment.

title: Shared accommodation requested by project team
description: Require voluntary consent, privacy and safety assessment; no coercive sharing.

title: Family member accompanies employee
description: Keep all companion costs personal unless a separately approved lawful exception applies.

title: Medical diversion during international travel
description: Prioritise emergency care, insurer assistance, safety escalation and later expense classification.

title: Border closure strands traveller abroad
description: Activate incident management, safe lodging, legal status and authorised repatriation planning.

title: Natural disaster during personal extension
description: Distinguish company duty-of-care scope and personal itinerary while responding to immediate safety needs.

title: Missed connection across separate tickets
description: Assess carrier responsibility, booking choices, employee conduct and emergency support before cost allocation.

title: Lost passport abroad
description: Use consular authorities, security support, identity protection and approved emergency travel funding.

title: Traveller detained or questioned by authorities
description: Prioritise safety and legal counsel; do not advise concealment or obstruction; notify authorised company contacts.

title: Local law conflicts with company travel standard
description: Follow applicable law, pause conflicting activity and obtain Legal/local expert direction.

title: Customer contract conflicts with local law
description: Do not assume contract overrides law; refer to Legal and local counsel.

title: Conflicting safety advice from sources
description: Prioritise competent official sources and internal security assessment; record source, timestamp and decision.

title: Travel during declared public emergency
description: Require incident command decision, risk acceptance and documented business necessity.

title: High-frequency cross-border travel fatigue
description: Trigger manager review, workload and wellbeing assessment, and alternative meeting options.

title: Long-haul travel followed by safety-critical work
description: Require rest/fatigue assessment and adjustment of work schedule before safety-critical duties.

title: Cross-border expense paid in multiple currencies
description: Retain transaction currency, converted amount, conversion method and local reporting fields.

title: Multi-country meal allowance calculation
description: Apply the governing country rule for each eligible period; prevent overlapping per diem and actual claims.

title: Country addendum silent on a spend category
description: Do not invent a cap; use global eligibility principles and obtain local Finance determination where needed.

title: Two policies produce different outcomes for same trip
description: Apply precedence, effective dates, jurisdiction and role facts; document interpretation or escalate ambiguity.

title: Post-trip discovery of undisclosed itinerary change
description: Reconstruct actual itinerary, assess safety/immigration/expense impact and record corrective action without presuming intent.

title: Travel request intake and completeness
description: Define required request fields, validation, missing-information follow-up and routing before approval.

title: Trip purpose and business case validation
description: Require a specific business outcome, necessity assessment, alternatives considered and project/customer linkage.

title: Travel budget reservation and forecast
description: Define budget hold, forecast updates, release of unused reservations and reconciliation to actual spend.

title: Cost centre and project code validation
description: Require valid active codes, accountable owner confirmation and controlled correction of miscoding.

title: Travel booking profile data quality
description: Maintain traveller identity, legal name, contact, loyalty and accessibility preferences with controlled updates.

title: Approved travel management company workflow
description: Define service scope, booking handoff, traveller support, escalation and transaction record requirements.

title: Direct supplier booking exception
description: Set conditions for direct booking, evidence capture, itinerary feed and reconciliation to central records.

title: Booking change and cancellation workflow
description: Define who may change bookings, compare change cost with alternatives and preserve approval trail.

title: Unused ticket credit management
description: Track credit owner, expiry, eligible reuse, transfer restrictions and periodic reconciliation.

title: Hotel booking and guarantee controls
description: Require approved channels, cancellation terms, guarantee method and clear separation of room and incidental charges.

title: Rail reservation and seat selection
description: Define class eligibility, seat selection principles, accessibility needs and local rail booking constraints.

title: Traveller profile and loyalty programme use
description: Permit personal loyalty benefits only where they do not increase company cost or conflict with supplier terms.

title: Travel desk service levels and escalation
description: Set intake prioritisation, response ownership, urgent case handling and service recovery tracking.

title: After-hours travel support
description: Define emergency contact channel, scope of assistance, escalation and next-business-day record completion.

title: Itinerary distribution and change notifications
description: Define secure itinerary delivery, acknowledgement, updates and traveller responsibility to review changes.

title: Traveller no-show and unused booking handling
description: Require prompt notification, supplier cancellation attempt, reason capture and avoidable-cost review.

title: Travel disruption rebooking authority
description: Define decision rights, safe alternatives, spend visibility and retrospective documentation during disruption.

title: Group booking passenger manifest controls
description: Limit access to necessary roster data, validate names and manage changes with privacy safeguards.

title: Travel supplier onboarding and due diligence
description: Require procurement, security, privacy, insurance and compliance checks proportionate to supplier risk.

title: Supplier performance and complaint management
description: Define service issue logging, evidence, owner, escalation, corrective action and periodic review.

title: Travel data privacy request handling
description: Route access, correction and deletion requests through approved privacy processes and legal retention checks.

title: Travel technology outage continuity
description: Define manual fallback, approval evidence, booking reconciliation and controlled restoration after outage.

title: Travel policy helpdesk knowledge management
description: Set article ownership, version linkage, review cadence, feedback loop and stale guidance retirement.

title: Travel programme operational handover
description: Require open-trip list, pending approvals, unresolved incidents, supplier contacts and accountable receiving owner.

title: Travel programme control self-assessment
description: Define periodic control owner attestations, evidence sampling, issue rating, remediation and closure validation.
